mutant.lineText: return [...this.view().cards.values()].filter((c) => c.due !== null && c.due < today && !this.isDone(c.id)).sort((a, b) => (a.due! < b.due! ? -1 : a.due! > b.due! ? 1 : a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1));
mutant.prevText: if (!validDay(today)) throw new BadOp('today must be a day like 2026-03-01');
